title: Validation and Test Audit

run_a.coverage: Happy path + duplicate + delete safety. Missing: sort validation, input validation, movement quantity update, RBAC enforcement.
run_a.classification_policy: None — no CLASSIFICATION_FIRST. No HONEST_SKIP annotation.

run_b.coverage: Happy path + duplicate + delete safety + sort validation + input validation + movement update. RBAC documented but not tested at API level.
run_b.classification_policy: CLASSIFICATION_FIRST enforced. 1 HONEST_SKIP with explicit ENV_MISMATCH reason.

verdict: RUN_B tests 57% more numerous, better coverage, CLASSIFICATION_FIRST policy reduces false confidence. RUN_A tests functional but limited.
